name: Invoice Tokenization (TReDS)
description: A TReDS-style receivable as a permissioned token (modelled on the M1xchange POC). Each RBI/TReDS-approved invoice is one non-fungible token in the use case's collection: the tokenId is the invoice's cryptographic fingerprint (hash of invoice + GSTINs + amount + due date), so a duplicate-financing attempt — minting the same invoice twice — is rejected by the ledger itself. Sensitive documents stay off-ledger (the token carries a document URL and the hash). Holders are KYC-verified, India-jurisdiction financiers on an allowlist; transfer = financier-to-financier assignment of the financed receivable; burn = repayment at maturity closes the lifecycle; freeze = default/dispute hold.

invoiceHash.description: Cryptographic fingerprint of (invoice + GSTINs + amount + due date) — also used as the tokenId for network-wide uniqueness

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number as raised by the MSME seller

invoiceDocUrl.description: Off-ledger document-vault link to the invoice/PO/GRN evidence (only the hash lives on-ledger)

tier.description: Supply-chain tier (1 = a direct anchor-buyer invoice; 2+ = deep-tier sub-supplier financed against its parent)

parentInvoiceHash.description: Deep-tier only: the parent invoice's tokenId this receivable is financed against

anchorBuyerGstin.description: Root anchor buyer whose credit underwrites the whole tier chain (inherited by every descendant)
